Both causes are highly impactful. Insecticide-treated bednets have an exceptionally strong evidence base for cost-effectiveness in saving human lives—particularly children's lives in malaria-endemic regions—and represent one of the most rigorously evaluated interventions in global health. Farmed-animal welfare reform addresses an enormous scale of suffering. I'll go with the option backed by the most robust and direct evidence of lives saved per dollar.
